run_eval_probs_cli: run the evaluation script with cli args like sigs and grid_name to evaluate brain decoding model signatures
run_Evaluator_load_test_data: run the Evaluator class to load test data from a solver and extract word hashes and predictions
run_run_eval_function: run the run_eval function to compute segment probabilities and top-k accuracy metrics for a trained model
run_EvalJob_call: run the EvalJob callable to evaluate a model signature across studies and save metadata and accuracy results
run_get_accuracy_from_probs: run the accuracy computation function to calculate top-k accuracy from probability distributions over a vocabulary
